name: Black Knight
def: Prototype unmanned ground combat vehicle from BAE Systems, resembling a tank, weighing about 12 tons and armed with a 30 mm gun, under evaluation by the US Army.
facts: Can be airlifted by a Lockheed C-130 Hercules
Also carries a 7.62 mm coaxial machine gun
Powered by a 300 horsepower (220 kW) Caterpillar diesel engine
